overall_goal: Log ingredient nutritional information and monitor the cooking onions

goals.description: Log the nutritional values of the ingredients into the phone app
goals.rationale: The person uses their phone to scan barcodes, check labels, and input the nutritional data of the tomato cans and sauce.

goals.description: Stir and monitor the onions cooking in the wok
goals.rationale: The person repeatedly mixes the onions with a spatula, shakes the wok, and watches them cook to ensure they do not burn.
